title: S01T01 - Define the public-beta wedge, audience, profiles, and non-goals
description: Write the product contract around resumable agent work and trustworthy closeout; define Simple, Team, and Governed profiles and explicitly exclude feature accumulation that does not support the wedge.
acceptanceCriteria: The public-beta audience, core promise, supported workflows, profiles, and non-goals are captured in one authoritative product document.
The document names which of the 161 commands are public golden-path surfaces, advanced surfaces, experimental surfaces, or internal compatibility surfaces.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
